slides.label: Day 1
slides.title: A labeled binder.
slides.body: Business license, bond, liability policy, workers' comp. Tabs. Sheet protectors. Gorgeous.

slides.label: Month 3
slides.title: The binder lives in the van now.
slides.body: Next to the mop heads and a bag of microfiber cloths.

slides.label: Month 6
slides.title: New office client: "Can you send your COI?"
slides.body: You send a photo of the binder page. It's from last year.

slides.label: Month 10
slides.title: "When does our bond renew?"
slides.body: Three people guess. Three different months.

slides.label: 1 year
slides.title: Workers' comp renewal email went to the old Gmail.
slides.body: The one only the previous office manager could log into.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: Day 1 binder energy, but with reminders.
slides.body: Write down when your license, bond, liability policy and workers' comp renew. Then check them before year-end.
